verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، إِنْ ضَمِنْتَ صَاحِبَكَ، إِنْ صَفَّقْتَ كَفَّكَ لِغَرِيبٍ،
verses.kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, [if] thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.web: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

verses.ar: إِنْ عَلِقْتَ فِي كَلَامِ فَمِكَ، إِنْ أُخِذْتَ بِكَلَامِ فِيكَ،
verses.kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.web: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

verses.ar: إِذًا فَٱفْعَلْ هَذَا يَا ٱبْنِي، وَنَجِّ نَفْسَكَ إِذَا صِرْتَ فِي يَدِ صَاحِبِكَ، ٱذْهَبْ تَرَامَ وَأَلِحَّ عَلَى صَاحِبِكَ.
verses.kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
verses.web: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

verses.ar: لَا تُعْطِ عَيْنَيْكَ نَوْمًا، وَلَا أَجْفَانَكَ نُعَاسًا.
verses.kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.web: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

verses.ar: نَجِّ نَفْسَكَ كَٱلظَّبْيِ مِنَ ٱلْيَدِ، كَٱلْعُصْفُورِ مِنْ يَدِ ٱلصَّيَّادِ.
verses.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand [of the hunter], and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.web: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

verses.ar: اِذْهَبْ إِلَى ٱلنَّمْلَةِ أَيُّهَا ٱلْكَسْلَانُ. تَأَمَّلْ طُرُقَهَا وَكُنْ حَكِيمًا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.web: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي لَيْسَ لَهَا قَائِدٌ أَوْ عَرِيفٌ أَوْ مُتَسَلِّطٌ،
verses.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.web: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

verses.ar: وَتُعِدُّ فِي ٱلصَّيْفِ طَعَامَهَا، وَتَجْمَعُ فِي ٱلْحَصَادِ أُكْلَهَا.
verses.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, [and] gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.web: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

verses.ar: إِلَى مَتَى تَنَامُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْكَسْلَانُ؟ مَتَى تَنْهَضُ مِنْ نَوْمِكَ؟
verses.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.web: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

verses.ar: قَلِيلُ نَوْمٍ بَعْدُ قَلِيلُ نُعَاسٍ، وَطَيُّ ٱلْيَدَيْنِ قَلِيلًا لِلرُّقُودِ،
verses.kjv: [Yet] a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.web: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

verses.ar: فَيَأْتِي فَقْرُكَ كَسَاعٍ وَعَوَزُكَ كَغَازٍ.
verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱللَّئِيمُ، ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلْأَثِيمُ يَسْعَى بِٱعْوِجَاجِ ٱلْفَمِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.web: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

verses.ar: يَغْمِزُ بِعَيْنَيْهِ. يَقُولُ بِرِجْلِهِ. يُشِيرُ بِأَصَابِعِهِ.
verses.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.web: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

verses.ar: فِي قَلْبِهِ أَكَاذِيبُ. يَخْتَرِعُ ٱلشَّرَّ فِي كُلِّ حِينٍ. يَزْرَعُ خُصُومَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: Frowardness [is] in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
verses.web: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

verses.ar: لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ بَغْتَةً تُفَاجِئُهُ بَلِيَّتُهُ. فِي لَحْظَةٍ يَنْكَسِرُ وَلَا شِفَاءَ.
verses.kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.web: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

verses.ar: هَذِهِ ٱلسِّتَّةُ يُبْغِضُهَا ٱلرَّبُّ، وَسَبْعَةٌ هِيَ مَكْرَهَةُ نَفْسِهِ:
verses.kjv: ¶ These six [things] doth the LORD hate: yea, seven [are] an abomination unto him:
verses.web: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

verses.ar: عُيُونٌ مُتَعَالِيَةٌ، لِسَانٌ كَاذِبٌ، أَيْدٍ سَافِكَةٌ دَمًا بَرِيئًا،
verses.kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.web: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.ar: قَلْبٌ يُنْشِئُ أَفْكَارًا رَدِيئَةً، أَرْجُلٌ سَرِيعَةُ ٱلْجَرَيَانِ إِلَى ٱلسُّوءِ،
verses.kjv: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.web: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

verses.ar: شَاهِدُ زُورٍ يَفُوهُ بِٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ، وَزَارِعُ خُصُومَاتٍ بَيْنَ إِخْوَةٍ.
verses.kjv: A false witness [that] speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.web: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، ٱحْفَظْ وَصَايَا أَبِيكَ وَلَا تَتْرُكْ شَرِيعَةَ أُمِّكَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.web: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

verses.ar: اُرْبُطْهَا عَلَى قَلْبِكَ دَائِمًا. قَلِّدْ بِهَا عُنُقَكَ.
verses.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, [and] tie them about thy neck.
verses.web: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

verses.ar: إِذَا ذَهَبْتَ تَهْدِيكَ. إِذَا نِمْتَ تَحْرُسُكَ، وَإِذَا ٱسْتَيْقَظْتَ فَهِيَ تُحَدِّثُكَ.
verses.kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and [when] thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.web: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْوَصِيَّةَ مِصْبَاحٌ، وَٱلشَّرِيعَةَ نُورٌ، وَتَوْبِيخَاتِ ٱلْأَدَبِ طَرِيقُ ٱلْحَيَاةِ.
verses.kjv: For the commandment [is] a lamp; and the law [is] light; and reproofs of instruction [are] the way of life:
verses.web: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

verses.ar: لِحِفْظِكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ ٱلشِّرِّيرَةِ، مِنْ مَلَقِ لِسَانِ ٱلْأَجْنَبِيَّةِ.
verses.kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.web: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

verses.ar: لَا تَشْتَهِيَنَّ جَمَالَهَا بِقَلْبِكَ، وَلَا تَأْخُذْكَ بِهُدُبِهَا.
verses.kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.web: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ بِسَبَبِ ٱمْرَأَةٍ زَانِيَةٍ يَفْتَقِرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ إِلَى رَغِيفِ خُبْزٍ، وَٱمْرَأَةُ رَجُلٍ آخَرَ تَقْتَنِصُ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلْكَرِيمَةَ.
verses.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman [a man is brought] to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.web: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

verses.ar: أَيَأْخُذُ إِنْسَانٌ نَارًا فِي حِضْنِهِ وَلَا تَحْتَرِقُ ثِيَابُهُ؟
verses.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.web: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

verses.ar: أَوَ يَمْشِي إِنْسَانٌ عَلَى ٱلْجَمْرِ وَلَا تَكْتَوِي رِجْلَاهُ؟
verses.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.web: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

verses.ar: هَكَذَا مَنْ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى ٱمْرَأَةِ صَاحِبِهِ. كُلُّ مَنْ يَمَسُّهَا لَا يَكُونُ بَرِيئًا.
verses.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْتَخِفُّونَ بِٱلسَّارِقِ وَلَوْ سَرِقَ لِيُشْبِعَ نَفْسَهُ وَهُوَ جَوْعَانٌ.
verses.kjv: [Men] do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.web: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

verses.ar: إِنْ وُجِدَ يَرُدُّ سَبْعَةَ أَضْعَافٍ، وَيُعْطِي كُلَّ قِنْيَةِ بَيْتِهِ.
verses.kjv: But [if] he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.web: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلزَّانِي بِٱمْرَأَةٍ فَعَدِيمُ ٱلْعَقْلِ. ٱلْمُهْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ هُوَ يَفْعَلُهُ.
verses.kjv: [But] whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he [that] doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
verses.web: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

verses.ar: ضَرْبًا وَخِزْيًا يَجِدُ، وَعَارُهُ لَا يُمْحَى.
verses.kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.web: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْغَيْرَةَ هِيَ حَمِيَّةُ ٱلرَّجُلِ، فَلَا يُشْفِقُ فِي يَوْمِ ٱلِٱنْتِقَامِ.
verses.kjv: For jealousy [is] the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.web: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

verses.ar: لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى فِدْيَةٍ مَّا، وَلَا يَرْضَى وَلَوْ أَكْثَرْتَ ٱلرَّشْوَةَ.
verses.kjv: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.web: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
